messages:
alice: Heads-up: new Fed POC asking for fully isolated, no-internet deployment. They prefer encrypted NVMe cartridges for delivery, want documented chain-of-custody, offline activation, and a proposed upgrade cadence. Need a ballpark for an offline packaging + signing add-on to include in the bid. Can @devin lead tech presales?

devin: Happy to. Quick questions: 1) Are GPUs provided in pilot? 2) Max single-file they will accept on a cartridge? 3) Do they require vendor-managed signing or customer keypair?

alice: Pilot is 3 servers, CPUs only initially. They said cartridge limit is ~256GB. They prefer customer-managed keys but will consider vendor-managed HSM if we justify.

maria: Ops notes: with CPU-only we must deliver quantized model variants (int8 or GPTQ). For cartridges: if any artifact >30GB, we convert to multipart images with resume support. Recommend NVMe + signed manifest and a small recovery tool.

maria: Example manifest lines we include in deliveries (for integrity):

```
manifest_version: 1
artifacts:
  - name: model-cxz-int8.bin
    parts: ["m001","m002"]
    sha256: 0f1e...
signed_by: redwood-release
```

theo: Security: customer requires FIPS-validated signing, offline cert rotation test, and proof of reproducible builds for quantized artifacts. They also want SBOM + signed provenance tarball. If we use vendor HSM, escrow timing impacts schedule.

contracts-bot: Heads-up: add export control clause for model quantization, and clarify liability for physical media loss during transit.

devin: Timeline question: they want monthly critical security updates and semiannual feature drops. We can commit to monthly security-only deltas and semiannual feature bundles, but delta build times for quantized weights are nontrivial (24	60h depending on size). Call this out.

maria: Operational caveat: delta generation for quantized weights often requires a full image rebuild to validate mmap offsets; that adds 1-3 days. We'll include a prebuild window in SOW.

alice: Commercial ask: ballpark for offline packaging + signing + one week of on-site validation? Need range to include in proposal.

contracts-bot: Preliminary band: $20k$55k for packaging & signing depending on number of artifacts and HSM work. On-site days billed separately. Final price after BOM.

theo: Acceptance checklist for SOW draft: 1) delivered cartridge validates against offline CA; 2) SBOM + signed provenance present; 3) install completes with no external DNS/NTP; 4) chunked resume verified; 5) cert rotation tested in staging; 6) rollback validated to previous signed image.

ops-bot: scheduled: staging offline rig available 2026-04-02 02:00-06:00 UTC for chunked-install and rollback tests.

devin: Action items: I will confirm ML sign-off on quantized fidelity and provide expected delta windows; maria to run a chunked-install smoke test on staging and post logs; theo to draft security acceptance wording. Alice to collect BOM + delivery constraints from buyer (ETA EOD).

alice: Thanks. I'll gather BOM and shipping preferences tonight. We will present three signing options to buyer: customer-supplied key, vendor HSM without escrow, vendor HSM with escrow (fees apply). Closing: emphasize encrypted NVMe + signed manifest + resumable installer as our recommended approach.
